notablePrerequisites: You control at least four basic lands.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phylath, adding {1}.
Phylath dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Phylath enters the battlefield, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Plants, adding {3}.
Repeat.
